selection_metric: mean AP across F1 F2 F3; same training strategy for paired feature contrast
calibration_selection: mean Brier in F2/F3, calibrator learned only from previous out-of-sample predictions available at each origin
threshold_selection: maximum F1 using available prior out-of-sample probabilities; grid .01..99; smallest tie
status: retrospective informed by V1; not historically blind; final block excluded from V2 selection
availability: historical publication timestamps absent; weather 1h after measurement and ONS labels 7d after interval end are explicit scenarios, not operational guarantees
